ko.title: 날아간 빨간 풍선
ko.body: 아기 여우 단이가 아끼던 빨간 풍선이 손에서 쑥 빠져나갔어요. 풍선은 하늘 높이 둥실둥실 날아가 버렸지요.

en.title: The Red Balloon Floats Away
en.body: Dani the little fox's beloved red balloon slipped right out of his hand. It floated up, up, high into the sky.

ko.title: 차오르는 눈물
ko.body: 단이의 눈에 굵은 눈물이 그렁그렁 맺혔어요. 가슴속이 텅 빈 것처럼 슬펐답니다.

en.title: Tears Welling Up
en.body: Big tears welled up in Dani's eyes. He felt so sad, as if his chest were empty inside.

ko.title: 울어도 괜찮아
ko.body: 엄마 여우가 다가와 단이를 가만히 안아 주었어요. 울어도 괜찮다고, 슬픈 마음은 자연스러운 거라고 했지요.

en.title: It's Okay to Cry
en.body: Mama Fox came over and held Dani gently. It's okay to cry, she said—feeling sad is only natural.
en.line: “You can cry as much as you need, Dani.”

ko.title: 마음을 털어놓기
ko.body: 단이는 풍선이 정말 좋았다고 엄마에게 말했어요. 슬픔을 말로 꺼내자 가슴이 조금 가벼워졌답니다.

en.title: Sharing His Heart
en.body: Dani told his mama how much he had loved that balloon. Once he put his sadness into words, his chest felt a little lighter.
en.line: “I loved it so much, that's why it hurt more.”

ko.title: 눈물이 그치고
ko.body: 한참 울고 나니 눈물이 조금씩 마르기 시작했어요. 단이는 손등으로 눈물을 쓱 닦았지요.

en.title: The Tears Stop
en.body: After crying for a while, his tears slowly began to dry. Dani wiped them away with the back of his hand.
en.line: The rain in his heart slowly stopped.

ko.title: 풍선의 여행
ko.body: 엄마는 풍선이 멀리 여행을 떠난 거라고 말해 주었어요. 어쩌면 구름 친구들과 놀고 있을지도 모른다고요.

en.title: The Balloon's Journey
en.body: Mama told him the balloon had gone off on a faraway journey. Maybe it was playing with its cloud friends, she said.
en.line: “So my balloon went off on an adventure.”

ko.title: 친구의 토닥임
ko.body: 지나가던 친구 토끼가 단이의 어깨를 토닥여 주었어요. 슬플 땐 곁에 있어 주는 친구가 큰 힘이 되었지요.

en.title: A Friend's Comfort
en.body: Rabbit, passing by, patted Dani gently on the shoulder. When you're sad, a friend by your side is a great comfort.

ko.title: 새로 만든 놀이
ko.body: 둘은 함께 색종이로 비행기를 접어 날렸어요. 슬픔이 가신 자리에 새로운 즐거움이 찾아왔답니다.

en.title: A Brand-New Game
en.body: Together they folded paper airplanes and sent them flying. Where the sadness had been, a new kind of fun arrived.
en.line: “This time I'll hold onto my airplane tight!”

ko.title: 마음에 든 햇살
ko.body: 구름 사이로 따뜻한 햇살이 비쳤어요. 단이의 마음에도 다시 환한 빛이 들어왔지요.

en.title: Sunlight in His Heart
en.body: Warm sunlight broke through between the clouds. A bright light came back into Dani's heart too.
en.line: After the sadness came the sunshine.

ko.title: 괜찮아진 마음
ko.body: 단이는 슬픈 날도 지나간다는 걸 알았어요. 곁에 있어 주는 사람들 덕분에 마음이 다시 따뜻해졌답니다.

en.title: A Heart Made Better
en.body: Dani learned that even sad days come to an end. Thanks to the people beside him, his heart grew warm again.
en.line: “It's okay to be sad. I can smile again.”
